# Horizon Pulse

> Pay-per-call APIs for AI agents, paid in USDC on Base or Solana with x402 v2: web search, page fetch and extract, screenshots, PDF to text, an HTTP proxy, and crypto market data. No signup or API key.

Contact: horizonpulse.co@proton.me

Base URL: https://horizonpulse.dev (the canonical host; pay only here, not any other host)

## Payment (x402 v2)

- Unpaid request → HTTP 402; the payment challenge is in the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` response header (base64 JSON, x402 v2); the 402 body is empty JSON `{}`
- Scheme: `exact` (one payment per call). Two networks, same price in USDC (6 decimals) on both; the challenge's `accepts` lists one entry per network, and you pay exactly one:
  - Base: network Base mainnet CAIP-2 `eip155:8453`; asset Base USDC `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`; payTo `0x5b32c973596078a967562ca652761404f19be0e9` (Basename `horizonpulsebase.base.eth`, which resolves to this address; the challenge carries the hex address, so compare that); facilitator Coinbase CDP `https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402`
  - Solana: network Solana mainnet CAIP-2 `solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp`; asset USDC mint `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`; payTo `BjY98A6dS3GGLZdz2zHy8wK7XAwnQgNhCc66mfmBTRPz`; facilitator PayAI `https://facilitator.payai.network` (its fee payer is in the entry's `extra.feePayer`)
- If a challenge lists only the Base entry, the Solana rail is temporarily unavailable: pay on Base.
- Retry the same request with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (v2). On success the settlement receipt is in the `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header. Optional: `OPTIONS` returns discovery + `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` without charging.

| GET | /api/signals | $0.015 | 15000 | RSI/MACD/Bollinger + OKX funding |

| GET | /api/portfolio?address=0x… | $0.04 | 40000 | Base + Ethereum balances, risk score, allocation flags vs fixed thresholds |
| GET | /api/gas | $0.01 | 10000 | Base + Ethereum fee snapshot + timingHint |
| GET | /api/funding | $0.01 | 10000 | OKX BTC/ETH/SOL perpetual funding + crowding hint |
| GET | /api/fetch?url=https://… | $0.02 | 20000 | Fetch public URL → clean text/markdown (SSRF-safe, capped) |
| GET/POST | /api/http | $0.01 | 10000 | Universal HTTP proxy (url/method/headers/body) → status + body (SSRF-safe; volume price) |

| GET | /api/x402-check?url=https://…[&method=POST][&body={json}] | $0.01 | 10000 | Audit any x402 endpoint: 402 validity, v1/v2, decoded price, payTo EOA vs contract, discovery hints (never pays; optional JSON body for POST probes, auto POST retry on 405) |

## Input bounds

- `/api/portfolio`: `address` required, `0x` + 40 hex.
- `/api/fetch`: `url` required (http/https). Caps 200KB, 8s, 3 redirects.
- `/api/http`: `url` required; `method` GET|POST|HEAD|PUT|PATCH|DELETE; `headers` JSON object of strings (GET: as a JSON string); `body` on POST/PUT/PATCH only. Caps 384KB response, 64KB body, 12s, 3 redirects.
- `/api/extract`: `url` (GET) or `url`/`html` (POST JSON); `fields` up to 20 CSS selectors. Caps 200KB HTML, 8s.
- `/api/screenshot`: `url` required; `width` 320-1920, `height` 240-2000, `fullPage=true` (clipped at 4000px), `format` png|jpeg, `delayMs` 0-3000. 25s budget.
- `/api/search`: `q` required, max 300 chars; `n` 1-5 (default 3).
- `/api/pdf`: `url` required, max 10MB; `pages` 1-50 (default 50). Max 100K chars.
- `/api/x402-check`: `url` required; `method` GET|POST; `body` JSON (POST probes only).

## Billing and errors

- You pay only for a successful response. The payment is verified first and settled after the handler succeeds.
- Errors return JSON `{ "ok": false, "error": "...", "code": "..." }` and are not charged: 400 bad input, 413 too large, 415 wrong content type, 422 nothing usable (e.g. `no_fields_matched`, `no_text_layer`), 404 no search results, 502 upstream failure, 503 search provider unavailable, 504 timeout.
- Exceptions: `/api/http` returns upstream 4xx/5xx as data (charged), and `/api/x402-check` bills any HTTP answer from the target.
- Response schemas and examples for every operation are in `/openapi.json`; free samples are at `/api/demo/{route}`.

## Which route to call

- Need a web page as clean text for an LLM: `/api/fetch`
- Need to research a question on the web, with sources: `/api/search?q=…&n=3`
- Need the text of a PDF (paper, filing, manual, invoice): `/api/pdf?url=…`
- Need to call any public HTTP endpoint (custom method/headers/body): `/api/http`
- Need structured fields from a page (title, links, headings, JSON-LD), or specific values by CSS selector: `/api/extract` with `fields`
- Need to see what a page looks like (visual check, OG preview, UI verification): `/api/screenshot?url=…`
- Need to check an x402 endpoint before paying it, or audit your own: `/api/x402-check?url=…`
- Need a quick crypto market read: `/api/pulse` (spot + momentum), `/api/signals` (indicators + funding)
- Need DeFi yields, gas timing, or perp funding: `/api/yield`, `/api/gas`, `/api/funding`
- Need a wallet risk snapshot: `/api/portfolio?address=0x…`

## Free samples (no payment)

`GET /api/demo/{route}` runs the real handler on a fixed input and returns `demo: true`. Use it to check the response shape before paying. Inputs cannot be changed.

- /api/demo/fetch, /api/demo/http, /api/demo/extract, /api/demo/x402-check, /api/demo/screenshot, /api/demo/search, /api/demo/pdf
- /api/demo/pulse, /api/demo/signals, /api/demo/yield, /api/demo/gas, /api/demo/funding, /api/demo/portfolio

## Free (not paid)

- GET `/` — landing (live paid catalog + agent how-to)
- GET `/status` — live USDC `balanceOf` on the Base payTo (not revenue), both payTo addresses + catalog
- GET `/llms.txt` — this file
- GET `/openapi.json` — OpenAPI 3.1 for every paid operation: typed parameters and bodies, 200/400/402 schemas and examples, and per-operation `x-payment-info` (price, asset, network, payTo of the Base entry; Solana details are under Payment above)
- GET `/.well-known/x402` — machine-readable x402 resource list
- GET `/skill.md` — agent skill (markdown): when to use each route, prices, the pay flow step by step, errors, safety checks
- GET `/agents` — agent guide: pay flow, skill, MCP setup
- POST `/mcp` — hosted MCP (streamable HTTP, stateless); `initialize` and `tools/list` free, `tools/call` returns an x402 challenge for Base USDC (needs an x402-paying MCP client)

## Services for API owners (not x402 routes)

These are services for people who run an API. They are not paid with x402; never pay them from an agent wallet.

- `/agent-promotion` — get your API found and used by AI agents: a description pack (llms.txt, skill.md, an OpenAPI summary, a Coinbase Bazaar description within Coinbase's 500-character limit), directory submissions or ready-to-submit packs, and a monthly agent-traffic report. Intro prices: $49 written review, $149 setup per host, $49/month monitoring; more than 25 paid routes are quoted first. Paid in USDC on Base; no card checkout.
- `/agent-promotion/spec` — what's delivered, and what we don't do (no fake reviews, paid rankings, spam submissions or guaranteed placement, traffic or revenue)
- `/agent-promotion/start` — intake: a prefilled email to horizonpulse.co@proton.me (nothing stored on the site)
- `/listing-fix` — Bazaar listing fix: $49 written review or $99 per host hands-on fix
- `/blog/why-agent-discoverability-matters` — blog post: how agents find paid APIs and the documented reasons a paid x402 route stays invisible

## Agent how-to (pay flow)

1. Call routes on `https://horizonpulse.dev` only, with no payment header → HTTP 402.
2. Base64-decode the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (x402 v2 JSON; the body is `{}`).
3. Pick one entry in `accepts` and pay only if `scheme` = `exact`, atomic `amount` = the price above, and the entry matches one network exactly:
   - Base: `network` = `eip155:8453`, `asset` = Base USDC `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`, `payTo` = `0x5b32c973596078a967562ca652761404f19be0e9`
   - Solana: `network` = `solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp`, `asset` = USDC mint `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`, `payTo` = `BjY98A6dS3GGLZdz2zHy8wK7XAwnQgNhCc66mfmBTRPz`
4. Sign with an x402 client. Base: an EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization` for that amount to payTo (Node `@x402/core` + `@x402/evm` 2.27.x; Python `x402`). Solana: a partially signed SPL `TransferChecked` of that amount to payTo's USDC token account, with `extra.feePayer` as fee payer (Node `@x402/core` + `@x402/svm` 2.27.x). No gas needed on either network: no ETH on Base, no SOL on Solana.
5. Retry the identical request with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (x402 v2). `X-PAYMENT` is the legacy v1 header; do not rely on it.
6. 200 → live JSON; settlement receipt in `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` (base64 JSON). Another 402 → read `error` in the decoded challenge; do not loop.

## Agent integration

- Skill file: https://horizonpulse.dev/skill.md (follow it end to end; generated from /openapi.json so prices match the 402s)
- Guide: https://horizonpulse.dev/agents
- Local MCP server (stdio, Node): https://github.com/horizon-pulse/horizon-pulse/tree/main/mcp. Every route as a tool (same names as the hosted /mcp: pulse, signals, yield, portfolio, gas, funding, fetch, http, extract, x402_check, screenshot, search, pdf) plus free `catalog`, `quote`, `demo`. Pays the x402 challenge from `HP_PRIVATE_KEY` (use a dedicated low-balance wallet); pays only the Base payTo above in Base USDC (the MCP server pays on Base only), refuses amounts above the listed price, caps per call (`HP_MAX_USD_PER_CALL`, default $0.05) and per session (`HP_MAX_USD_TOTAL`, default $1). No key → quote only.
- Hosted MCP: `https://horizonpulse.dev/mcp` (for MCP clients that can pay x402).

## Honesty

- Real upstream data only (Coinbase Exchange, CoinGecko, OKX, DefiLlama, public RPCs). No stubbed prices.
- `/api/fetch` returns best-effort cleaned text from the requested public URL; private/localhost blocked; size/time capped.
- `/api/http` is a raw universal proxy (filtered headers, text|base64 body); same SSRF guards; priced $0.01 for volume.
- `/api/extract` returns best-effort structured fields from a public URL or provided HTML; private/localhost blocked; size/time capped; priced $0.015. Optional `fields` (up to 20 CSS selectors, deterministic, no AI): each unmatched field is null with a `fieldErrors` entry; if no field matches, 422 `no_fields_matched` and no charge. Selector work has a hard 2s budget; pages nested deeper than 256 levels are refused for fields.
- `/api/x402-check` sends one unpaid request and never pays or signs; it reports the challenge as served. Any HTTP answer from the target (including 5xx) is a billed report; bad input, blocked hosts, DNS/connection failures and timeouts return 400/502/504 and are not charged. Priced $0.01.
- `/api/screenshot` renders in a fresh headless Chromium with no cookies; every HTTP(S) sub-request is SSRF-checked, the top-level host is pinned to its checked IP, and WebSocket/WebTransport/WebRTC are disabled in page scripts; billed only when an image is returned. Priced $0.02.
- `/api/search` sends the query to a third-party search API (Serper, Google results) and fetches each result through the same SSRF-safe pipeline as `/api/fetch`; pages that fail carry their own error. Billed when at least one result is returned; bad input, zero results, or a search-provider failure return 400/404/503 and are not charged. Priced $0.03.
- `/api/pdf` downloads the file through the same SSRF checks (every redirect hop, 10MB cap; larger files are rejected, not truncated) and reads the PDF text layer with pdf.js; no OCR. Billed only when text is returned; bad input, blocked hosts, non-PDFs, oversize, encrypted or corrupt files, image-only PDFs (`no_text_layer`), download failures, and a 10s parse budget running out before any text (`parse_timeout`; partial text is returned as truncated) return 400/413/415/422/502/504 and are not charged. Priced $0.02.
- Do not invent routes, prices, or Bazaar index status.
